انخفضت (form VII)

# اِنْخَفَضْتَ (inḵafaḍta) /in.xa.fadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# اِنْخَفَضْتِ (inḵafaḍti) /in.xa.fadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْخَفَضَ (inḵafaḍa)
# اِنْخَفَضَتْ (inḵafaḍat) /in.xa.fa.dˤat/: third-pe
